prompt: explain why the sales dip happened in 2023 and show me on the charts comaprison with other years
title: Sales Dip Analysis 2023
summary: Explain why sales declined in 2023 and compare the trend against other years using charts.
executed_sql_queries:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS year,
       EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS month,
       SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
       SUM(oi.total_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS average_order_value
FROM retail.orders o
JOIN retail.order_items oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2022-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date)
ORDER BY year, month;

WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM retail.orders o
  JOIN retail.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2020-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  year,
  total_sales,
  total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS yoy_absolute_change,
  CASE
    WHEN LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year) IS NULL OR LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(((total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year)) / LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY year)) * 100.0, 2)
  END AS yoy_percent_change
FROM yearly_sales
ORDER BY year;

WITH yearly_store_sales AS (
  SELECT
    o.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year,
    SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.orders o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN retail.stores s
    ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.store_id, s.store_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    store_id,
    store_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2022,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2024
  FROM yearly_store_sales
  GROUP BY store_id, store_name
)
SELECT
  store_id,
  store_name,
  sales_2022,
  sales_2023,
  sales_2024,
  (sales_2023 - sales_2022) AS yoy_abs_change_2023_vs_2022,
  CASE WHEN sales_2022 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((sales_2023 - sales_2022) / sales_2022) * 100.0, 2) END AS yoy_pct_change_2023_vs_2022,
  (sales_2024 - sales_2023) AS yoy_abs_change_2024_vs_2023,
  CASE WHEN sales_2023 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((sales_2024 - sales_2023) / sales_2023) * 100.0, 2) END AS yoy_pct_change_2024_vs_2023
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY store_name;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        pt.type_name AS product_type,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.order_id::text::date) AS year,
        SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN retail.products p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN retail.categories c
        ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    JOIN retail.product_types pt
        ON p.type_id = pt.type_id
    WHERE oi.order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND oi.order_id IN (
          SELECT o.order_id
          FROM retail.orders o
          WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
            AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
      )
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, pt.type_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.order_id::text::date)
)
SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    product_type,
    year,
    total_sales,
    total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (
        PARTITION BY category_id, category_name, product_type
        ORDER BY year
    ) AS yoy_abs_change,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(total_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category_id, category_name, product_type
            ORDER BY year
        ) IS NULL OR LAG(total_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category_id, category_name, product_type
            ORDER BY year
        ) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category_id, category_name, product_type
            ORDER BY year
        )) / LAG(total_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category_id, category_name, product_type
            ORDER BY year
        ) * 100.0
    END AS yoy_pct_change
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY category_name, product_type, year;

WITH category_year_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.category_id,
        c.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS year,
        SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_sales
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN retail.orders o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN retail.products p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN retail.categories c
        ON p.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2022-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int
), yoy AS (
    SELECT
        category_id,
        category_name,
        year,
        total_sales,
        LAG(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY year) AS prev_year_sales,
        LEAD(total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY year) AS next_year_sales
    FROM category_year_sales
)
SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    year,
    total_sales,
    prev_year_sales,
    ROUND(total_sales - prev_year_sales, 2) AS yoy_abs_change,
    ROUND((total_sales - prev_year_sales) / NULLIF(prev_year_sales, 0) * 100.0, 2) AS yoy_pct_change,
    next_year_sales,
    ROUND(next_year_sales - total_sales, 2) AS next_yoy_abs_change,
    ROUND((next_year_sales - total_sales) / NULLIF(total_sales, 0) * 100.0, 2) AS next_yoy_pct_change
FROM yoy
ORDER BY category_name, year;
